gain.en: A traditional definition of corruption is the abuse of public office for personal gain.
gain.zh: 对腐败的一个传统定义是：滥用公权力以谋取私利。

gain.en: Politicians might accept a bribe from companies hoping to gain access to valuable resources.
gain.zh: 政客可能会接受希望获得宝贵资源准入的公司的贿赂。

gain.en: I think perhaps the most important insight I gained was how necessity accelerates learning.
gain.zh: 我想我得到的最大感悟或许是需求如何加速学习。

gain.en: Now, while both of these are perhaps interesting ideas, they have never gained serious traction.
gain.zh: 现在，虽然这两个可能都是有趣的想法，但它们从未真正获得广泛认可。

gain.en: The Republican party in Texas wants to gain more seats in Congress.
gain.zh: 得克萨斯州的共和党希望在国会中获得更多席位。

garlic.en: Yes, Beth. I asked you which variety of garlic grew in the former USSR.
garlic.zh: 是的，贝丝。我问过你哪种大蒜品种生长在前苏联。

garlic.en: According to Hinduism also, garlic is considered a food which is called a 'tamasic' food.
garlic.zh: 根据印度教的说法，大蒜也被认为是一种被称为“tamasic（惰性）”的食物。

garlic.en: That's anything from blackberries and chestnuts to mushrooms and wild garlic.
garlic.zh: 从黑莓、栗子到蘑菇和野蒜，什么都有。

garlic.en: Secondly, and on a related point and bucking the French stereotype, they must avoid garlic, as well as other spicy foods, because they too mean that you can’t differentiate as well between scents.
garlic.zh: 其次，顺着这个话题，打破法国人的刻板印象，他们必须避开大蒜以及其他辛辣食物，因为这些食物同样意味着你无法很好地分辨出气味之间的差异。

gather.en: On the night of the 9th of November, 1989, crowds gathered at Berlin’s border crossings.
gather.zh: 1989年11月9日晚，人群聚集在柏林的边境口岸。

gather.en: They fished in rivers and in coastal waters and gathered seeds and fruits.
gather.zh: 他们在河流和沿海水域捕鱼，并采集种子和水果。

gather.en: It was designed for crowds to gather there and watch gladiator fights or animal hunts.
gather.zh: 它旨在让民众聚集在那里观看角斗士决斗或猎兽表演。

gather.en: But Cortez did not give up. He regrouped, gathered more indigenous allies and returned to Tenochtitlán in 1521.
gather.zh: 但科尔特斯并没有放弃。他重新整顿队伍，集结了更多土著盟友，并于1521年回到了特诺奇蒂特兰。

gather.en: Still, people came out in their droves. Thousands of people gathered in Cairo, Alexandria, and cities across the country.
gather.zh: 尽管如此，人们还是成群结队地走出来。成千上万的人聚集在开罗、亚历山大以及全国各地的城市。

gap.en: That said, that same leverage is increasing the gap between the haves and have-nots.
gap.zh: 话虽如此，同样的杠杆作用也在扩大贫富差距。

gap.en: It creates a small gap between your conscious observation, self, and your mind.
gap.zh: 它在你的意识观察者、自我和你的思想之间创造了一个小小的间隙。

gap.en: It can also hide gaps in your vocabulary or your grammar.
gap.zh: 它还会掩盖你词汇或语法上的漏洞。

gap.en: Seung helped us to bridge that gap. For more HIDDEN BRAIN, you can follow us on Facebook and Twitter.
gap.zh: Seung 帮我们跨越了这道鸿沟。想要收听更多 HIDDEN BRAIN，您可以在 Facebook 和 Twitter 上关注我们。

gap.en: And the gap in potential between you and the person that you could have been begins to get more stark.
gap.zh: 你与你本可以成为的人之间的潜力差距开始变得更加鲜明。

garbage.en: But the word garbage is used to emphasize the negative feeling towards the food.
garbage.zh: 但使用“垃圾”这个词是为了强调对这种食物的负面感受。

garbage.en: An example would be when someone says, “this food tastes like garbage”.
garbage.zh: 一个例子就是当有人说：“这食物尝起来像垃圾”。

garbage.en: So, what is the name of Pixar's friendly robot who picks up garbage on an uninhabited planet Earth in the year 2805?
garbage.zh: 那么，在2805年荒无人烟的地球上捡垃圾的那位皮克斯友好机器人叫什么名字？

garbage.en: I asked you for the name of Pixar's friendly robot, who picks up garbage on an uninhabited planet Earth in the year 2805.
garbage.zh: 我问过你那个皮克斯友好机器人的名字，它在2805年荒凉的地球上清理垃圾。

garbage.en: Every poem ever written by an LM is garbage.
garbage.zh: LM写的每一首诗都是垃圾。

gamble.en: He then started to sell opium and opened brothels and gambling dens on Christmas Island.
gamble.zh: 然后他开始在圣诞岛上出售鸦片，并开设妓院和赌场。

gamble.en: Then it was Nevada, still gambling. And finally Los Angeles.
gamble.zh: 然后是内华达，他依旧在赌桌上打转。最后，他来到了洛杉矶。

gamble.en: Yeah. Men just get like pissed. Masturbate, gamble.
gamble.zh: 男人不那样做。他们只是喝酒或者直接……

gamble.en: He was actually quite good, he would later claim, and made more money through gambling than he did through his official job as a lawman.
gamble.zh: 他后来声称自己牌技相当不错，靠赌博赚的钱比当执法官的正职收入还要多。

gamble.en: Well, you could, of course, sit around playing cards, drinking port, and gambling your family’s fortune away, as it seemed Percy Fawcett’s father did.
gamble.zh: 嗯，你当然可以闲坐着打牌、喝波特酒，把家族的财富挥霍一空，看起来 Percy Fawcett 的父亲就是这么做的。

gay.en: Here he was, finally happily living as a gay man a half dozen years later.
gay.zh: 六年后的今天，他终于过上了快乐的同性恋生活。

gay.en: He's 37 now. He also wrote that since he was about 10, he knew he was gay.
gay.zh: 他现在37岁了。他还写道，从他大约10岁起，他就知道自己是同性恋。

gay.en: And despite this, he was persecuted. He was persecuted for being a gay man in 1950s Britain.
gay.zh: 尽管如此，他还是遭到了迫害。他在 20 世纪 50 年代的英国因为身为同性恋而遭到迫害。

gay.en: The editor of Gay News, Denis Lemon, was convicted.
gay.zh: 《Gay News》的主编 Denis Lemon 被判有罪。

gay.en: Alan Turing was a gay man in 1950s Britain.
gay.zh: Alan Turing 是 20 世纪 50 年代英国的一名同性恋者。

gathering.en: Now that same week, a few days earlier, across the river in Brooklyn, I went to a completely different kind of gathering.
gathering.zh: 就在那个星期，几天前，在河对岸的布鲁克林，我去了另一个完全不同聚会。

gathering.en: You know, the church gatherings where they sing the Amish chants and feeling like there’s a sense of legacy almost in that.
gathering.zh: 你知道的，他们唱着阿米什圣歌的教堂聚会，以及其中几乎带有一种传承感的感觉。

gathering.en: In fact, the “university” was more of an idea than a formal structure; it was really an informal gathering of young men who congregated in the same place and hired older, more learned men to instruct them.
gathering.zh: 事实上，“大学”与其说是一个正式的结构，不如说是一个概念；它其实是一群年轻人的非正式聚会，他们聚集在同一个地方，并雇佣年长、更有学问的人来教导他们。

garment.en: In 1909, the United Kingdom passed something called the Trade Boards Act, which established wage boards to set minimum wages in industries that were considered especially exploitative, things like garment work, where mainly women and children were exploited, forced to work long hours in terrible conditions for very low pay.
garment.zh: 1909 年，英国通过了《贸易委员会法》（Trade Boards Act），设立了工资委员会，为那些被认为剥削特别严重的行业设定最低工资，比如服装业，那里主要是妇女和儿童受到剥削，被迫在恶劣的条件下长时间工作，报酬却极低。

galaxy.en: But it’s not just in living things. Hurricane spirals, galaxies, and even the structure of DNA reflect this ratio, almost as if the universe itself is built on a foundation of mathematical elegance.
galaxy.zh: 但这不仅存在于生物中。飓风螺旋、星系，甚至 DNA 的结构都反映了这个比例，几乎就像宇宙本身就是建立在数学优雅的基础之上一样。

gasoline.en: This iconic descent took place in something called a Bathyscaphe, which looks a little bit like an airship, a Zeppelin, and consists of a small round pressure sphere at the bottom, where the two men would sit, and a large collection of tanks filled with gasoline in order to keep the device buoyant.
gasoline.zh: 这次标志性的下潜是在一种叫做“里雅斯特号”深海潜水器（Bathyscaphe）的设备中进行的，它看起来有点像飞艇或齐柏林飞艇，由底部的圆形耐压球体（两名男子坐在那里）和一大批充满汽油的舱体组成，以保持装置的浮力。

gallery.en: You can see his works of art in the most famous museums and galleries in cities across the world.
gallery.zh: 你可以在世界各地城市的著名博物馆和画廊里看到他的艺术作品。

gauge.en: But dig a layer deeper, and you find that some of the smartest people are not very smart when it comes to gauging the emotional temperature of a situation.
gauge.zh: 但再往深挖一层就会发现，有些最聪明的人，在判断一个场合的情绪温度时，其实并不怎么“聪明”。

garage.en: And when I was sleeping on the gym floor, I'll give you a detail that. that'll tell you that the stack of a denial proof, was that my first gym was underneath of a parking garage.
garage.zh: 当我睡在健身房地板上时，我给你一个细节，那会告诉你那堆不可否认的证据，就是我的第一个健身房是在一个停车场下面。

gang.en: You may recognize that name. We wrote about his exploits in Freakonomics; as a grad student in Chicago, Venkatesh embedded himself with a crack gang, and got access to their financial records.
gang.zh: 你可能认得这个名字。我们在《魔鬼经济学》中写过他的事迹；作为芝加哥大学的研究生，文卡特什曾深入一个贩毒帮派内部，并获得了他们的财务记录。
